summary: Remove 11/104 from the grain example's reference bundle.
rationale: The supplied verse gathers Christian children for teaching, not grain. Keep the other citations.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC Ishaq Material culture/107)

data.turoyo: Hul lu+yawmo du+nqolo, mitalimiwa; malimíwanne ʕal aḥ+ḥmore, baš+šale.
data.translation: Until the day of transporting, they would be gathered; they would gather them upon donkeys, in carpet bags.

rationale: New Detransitive Infectum-wa box; gathered state followed by active III gathering.

summary: New sense 1b: (ein einzelnes Kind) aufheben, aufnehmen
rationale: The farmer takes up one boy lying on the road and puts him into a bag; one clear uptake attestation, not group assembly.

summary: New sense 1: (Detrans.) sich sammeln, gesammelt werden;
rationale: Make the inherited unnumbered Detransitive gathering use explicit for new examples; this labels the existing meaning, not a new semantic contrast. The old Infectum assembly and MAC gathered-state Infectum-wa support the definition.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (JL 17.5/15)

data.turoyo: Gmalimiwayna aḥ=ḥeṭanək d similan barġal, gʕərwiwaynanne bu=ʕarbolo.
data.translation: sammelten wir diesen Weizen, den wir zu Weizengrütze gemacht hatten, und siebten ihn mit einem ʢarbolo (feineren Sieb).

rationale: Thin III Infectum-wa cell; explicit wheat patient and processing sequence.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (JL 18.6/1)

data.turoyo: W yawmo deri, haka ṯeləṯ yawmo gəzzawayna gəmfaydiwaynalan tre=gorəsyoṯe, rabe hawxa, w gdamṭiwaynanne gəzzawayna bayn i=qriṯo gmalimiwayna hawxa kmo=kačkat,
data.translation: Am folgenden Tag oder am dritten Tag gingen wir und suchten uns zwei große Handmühlen, und wir gingen ins Dorf und holten ein paar Mädchen zusammen,

rationale: Thin III Infectum-wa cell; animate patient in customary processing.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC Ishaq Material culture/77)

data.turoyo: Malimiwa kefe, bonanwa bayto manne, bayto dlo+čimənto, dlo+ṫə+mede (CHECK).
data.translation: They would gather stones, they would build a house out of them, a house without cement, without anything.

rationale: Fills III Infectum-wa to five; stones and MAC English evidence, retaining CHECK.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (JTM 3.4/10)
rationale: Unusual active III reciprocal object; no Detransitive form.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 6/25)

data.turoyo: w hulele kon w maləmlele kul bayto qanyono w ʕwono w gamlo w hulele.
data.translation: dann gab er ihm ein Zelt, sammelte ihm von jeder Familie ein Rind, ein Schaf und ein Kamel und schenkte sie ihm;

rationale: Unusual -lele beneficiary and distributive household source.

summary: example for sense 1b in Preterit (PrS 24/1)

data.turoyo: Kətwo zlam, u šuġlayḏe daworo we. Azze u ḥa yawmo lu dworo. Ḥzele zʕuro mḥalqo bu darbo, maləmle u zʕuro, maḥatle bi ture.
data.translation: Es war einmal ein Mann, der trieb Ackerbau. Als er eines Tages pflügen ging, fand er einen Knaben auf dem Wege liegen, hob ihn auf und steckte ihn in seinen Futtersack;

rationale: Single clear attestation of new restricted uptake subsense 1b.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (3/19)

data.turoyo: Kmaləm u bahro, d kʕobər b gawe di ʕayno. W kmanfəl u xayal du mede ʕal i dukṯo, d kətyo lu šəkəl du mire.
data.translation: (Die Pupille) sammelt das Licht, das in das Auge eintritt, und läßt das Luftbild des gegenstaudes auf eine Spiegelartige stelle fallen.

rationale: Unusual optical collector and light patient; participant extension.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (3/43)

data.turoyo: U qaruṭo kmaləm u ḥəs w ktufakle l lawġul w bu šəklano kšəmʕina.
data.translation: Der Knorpel (die Ohrmuschel) sammelt die Töne und stößt sie nach innen, und auf diese Weise hören wir.

rationale: Unusual body-part collector and sound patient, paired with 3/19.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (11/104)

data.turoyo: Bu qayṭo ste kmalimi an naʕime suryoye, d kit b hawir di dayro, kmawləfi lan naʕimani taʕlimi masiḥi w ṣlawoṯo.
data.translation: Im Sommer holen sie die christlichen Kinder zusammen, die um das Kloster herum wohnen, und unterrichten diese Kinder in Christenlehre und Gebeten.

rationale: Clear animate patient with teaching purpose; also establishes the erroneous inherited grain citation.

summary: example for sense 1 in Imperativ (PrS 35/5)

data.translation: geht hin und sammelt ein Heer aus den Bohtân-Kurden

rationale: Thin Imperativ cell; plural alimu contrasts with inherited singular.

summary: example for sense 1 in Imperativ (PrS 36/9)

data.turoyo: Nfal bayn u balad, krax aləm ʕaskar.
data.translation: Mach dich auf in das Land, zieh umher und bringe ein Heer zusammen

rationale: Thin Imperativ cell; aləm variant in coordinated commands.

summary: example for sense 1 in Imperativ (PrS 57/42)
rationale: Thin Imperativ cell; l-beneficiary and understood money.

summary: example for sense 1 in Imperativ (PrS 60/90)

data.turoyo: D laydi ak kətoṯo, aləm ab beʕe.
data.translation: Wenn die Hühner Eier legen, so sammelst du dieselben.

rationale: Fills Imperativ to five; explicit eggs and temporal condition.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (MAC Ishaq Material culture/33)

data.turoyo: Lu+gorā̀n, ṭabi, du+maḏʕo, du+šmoʕo, layimi b̰ Mōr Malke, ŭ tamo yani mdafaʕʕe ruḥayye ʕam ḥḏoḏe, aq+qəryawoṯe, yani...
data.translation: According to the information, to the rumours, they gathered in Mor Malke, and there, like, they defended themselves together, the villages, like...

rationale: Thin I cell; independent MAC evidence and locative b̰.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (69/45)

data.translation: Am Abend trat die Ratsversammlung zusammen

rationale: Thin I cell; singular collective subject.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (70/94)

data.turoyo: Komər layimi kulle l qarʕe du gər,
data.translation: Alle Vögel versammelten sich auf dem Gipfel des Hügels.

rationale: Fills I cell to five with an aligned animal-subject extension.

summary: Move 32/7 from the translation into references
before: Aus den anderen Dörfern der Muhammedaner kamen sie und sammelten sich rings um das Dorf und kämpften nunmehr mit ihnen (mit dem Volk von ‘Iwardo)’; 32/7
after: Aus den anderen Dörfern der Muhammedaner kamen sie und sammelten sich rings um das Dorf und kämpften nunmehr mit ihnen (mit dem Volk von ‘Iwardo)
rationale: The translation field ends with the closing quotation delimiter and '; 32/7', while refs is empty. This is a reference captured as translation text. Retain 32/7 in refs and end the translation at the closing parenthesis.

summary: Correct translation: 'mussten sein Diener' → 'mussten seine Diener'
rationale: The plural verb 'mussten' and the plural noun 'Diener' require 'seine Diener'; 'sein' has lost its final e.

summary: I layəm/loyəm expresses assembly; III maləmle/maləm gathers a patient. Active III plus ḥḏoḏe gives reciprocal assembly (JTM 3.4/10; PrS 72/111), without proving objectless active III.
III Infectum-wa describes customary gathering of eggs, grain, cotton and stones. 25/4 remains Infectum-wa despite German pluperfect; 69/310 has completed anterior gathering in Preterit-wa.

MAC mitalimiwa supplies Detransitive Infectum-wa with a gathered state lasting until transport. Added sense 1 denotes the inherited unnumbered Detransitive gathering use; no new Detransitive sense is introduced.
Existing Detransitive Infinitiv tulimo/telimo can denote active gathering with genitive patients (raisins, people, clothes). Category placement does not entail agentless semantics.
PrS 12/2 and 57/89 duplicate inherited prs 27/24 and 155/22. Keep edition numbers pending concordance.
Compact records lack verses; their retained classifications are provisional and cannot be independently checked.
In Bilgic Der Beruf eines Kesselverzinkers/29, is maləm (buwe) gathering, consolidating copper, or a named metal-working operation?
Is PrS 78/59 malimi active III Infectum or reduced Detransitive?
Confirm I laym-/loym-: MAC Ishaq Material culture/114 dlaymiwa as Preterit-wa, and 94/78 layime as an independent Part act. after kowən.
Should active event nouns tulimo/telimo remain under Detransitive Infinitiv, and how should they be numbered?
Provide the PrS edition concordance for prs 27/24 = PrS 12/2 and prs 155/22 = PrS 57/89.
At JL 13.12/9 what is the function of i=gera, and at JTM 1.1/95 who gathers salt?
Confirm malimənne segmentation at 25/73, Maləmme agent number at PrS 5/18, and the second -le beneficiary at PrS 57/39.
Birds gather like human groups; participant extension.
Optical or auditory body parts gather light or sound, without a new technical sense.
Village denotes inhabitants; pooling liquids and obtaining medicinal material preserve the collecting meaning.
